kept.title: Engineering Technical Officer - Engineering Design
kept.apply_instructions: Apply via City of South Perth website careers portal (link-out from SEEK). Contact Kevin Chung, Civil Design Coordinator, 08 9474 0777. Close 4pm AWST Friday 16 October 2026.
rationale: Diploma or equivalent in Civil Engineering is met by Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (Feb 2026).
Road and drainage design with AutoCAD and Civil 3D matches coursework; Victorian C-class equivalent licence and willingness for police check are on record.
Previous urban road/drainage design experience is academic only; no Australian council design experience yet.
kept.caution: Commercial urban road/drainage design experience is academic; Perth role needs relocation discussion.
gaps: Australian commercial road and drainage design experience
